user_problem: Proposed logs may omit diagnostic context, leak prohibited fields, or use inconsistent event identifiers.
unique_output: A review table mapping each log template to required fields, prohibited fields, severity rules, and repair notes.
required_input: Proposed log templates, event definitions, required context list, redaction policy, and severity guidance.
critical_rule: Evaluate only declared fields and policies; never request secrets or infer that a log proves runtime behavior.
nearest_existing_and_difference: Nearest is configuration-drift-explainer; this reviews static observability contracts rather than explaining configuration changes.
acceptance_scenario: Input event payment_rejected requires order_id and reason_code, forbids card_number, severity warning. Template contains order_id and card_number. Output flags missing reason_code, prohibited card_number, and confirms warning severity.
